job.title: Consultant SAP Commerce Cloud / mit remote

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Consultant | Senior Java & Integration Expert | SAP CX
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with over 5 years of experience delivering enterprise-grade SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot and REST/OCC APIs, I design and implement end-to-end e-commerce flows, integrate product data from PIM, ERP and MDM systems, and optimise performance and reliability. I work in a techno-functional capacity, translating business requirements into robust solutions, coordinating international stakeholders, and managing CI/CD, production support and release activities.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Consultant SAP Commerce Cloud / mit remote
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Leuchtmehr’s ambition to shape modern digital buying experiences and to integrate SAP CX components across a global manufacturing landscape. With over five years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I combine deep technical expertise with a proven techno-functional consulting approach that aligns perfectly with this role.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Expertise
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I designed and implemented end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) features covering product, pricing and customer data, ensuring platform stability and scalability.

bullets.label: Integration & Data Pipelines
bullets.text: I built and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub, and resolved integration bottlenecks with SAP ERP and MDM, delivering seamless data flow across systems.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: Working in a techno-functional role, I gathered business requirements, authored user stories and functional specifications, and coordinated with international stakeholders to translate needs into robust SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: Production & Release Management
bullets.text: I managed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2), oversaw incident, change and release activities, and provided production support that reduced downtime and improved performance.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, I hold a valid German residence and work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to Leuchtmehr.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Consultant SAP Commerce Cloud / mit remote
cover_de.hook: Die Vision von Leuchtmehr, digitale Einkaufserlebnisse zu gestalten und SAP-CX-Lösungen in einem internationalen Fertigungsumfeld zu vernetzen, begeistert mich. Mit über fünf Jahren Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Optimierung von SAP Commerce Cloud-Plattformen bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich tiefes technisches Know-how und eine bewährte techno-funktionale Beratung mit.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Expertise
bullets.text: Bei Rockwell Automation habe ich End-to-End-Funktionen auf SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) entwickelt, die Produkt-, Preis- und Kundendaten abdecken und die Plattformstabilität sichern.

bullets.label: Integration & Datenpipelines
bullets.text: Ich habe PIM-zu-Hybris-Datenpipelines mit Profisee, Hotfolders und DataHub aufgebaut und Optimierungen bei der Integration von SAP ERP und MDM durchgeführt, um einen nahtlosen Datenaustausch zu gewährleisten.

bullets.label: Techno-funktionale Beratung
bullets.text: In meiner techno-funktionalen Rolle habe ich Geschäftsanforderungen erfasst, User Stories und Funktionsspezifikationen erstellt und mit internationalen Stakeholdern zusammengearbeitet, um robuste SAP Commerce-Lösungen zu realisieren.

bullets.label: Produktions- & Release-Management
bullets.text: Ich habe CI/CD-Deployments im SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) gesteuert, Incident-, Change- und Release-Aktivitäten koordiniert und den Produktionssupport geleistet, wodurch Ausfallzeiten reduziert und die Performance gesteigert wurden.

cover_de.logistics: Ich lebe in Karlsruhe, verfüge über eine gültige deutsche Aufenthaltserlaubnis, befinde mich in der Kündigungsfrist bis zum 15.12.2026 und kann ab dem 16.12.2026 starten. Ich freue mich auf ein Gespräch.

tailoring.why_company: Leuchtmehr’s focus on creating seamless digital purchase journeys and its commitment to advancing the SAP CX landscape align perfectly with my passion for innovative e-commerce solutions. The opportunity to work on international SAP Commerce, Sales Cloud and S/4HANA integrations within a forward-thinking manufacturing environment excites me, and the remote-friendly culture matches my collaborative, tech-driven work style.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to help Leuchtmehr build cutting-edge digital commerce experiences by leveraging my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise, integration know-how, and techno-functional consulting background.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m very interested in the Consultant SAP Commerce Cloud role at Leuchtmehr and would love to discuss how my integration and techno-functional experience can add value.
tailoring.email_subject: Application – Consultant SAP Commerce Cloud (Leuchtmehr GmbH)
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Consultant SAP Commerce Cloud position at Leuchtmehr. With over five years of hands-on experience in SAP Commerce Cloud development, integration and techno-functional consulting, I am eager to contribute to your digital commerce initiatives.

Kind regards,
